title: A bounded parallel workflow can expose migration risks
text: Ismail proposes an isolated AI-enabled counterpart of a predictable workflow, compared with the existing process before broader migration. The useful element is the protected comparison and staged decision; it does not require accepting the wider forecast about the future shape of companies.
qualification: Conceptual proposal. A parallel run must avoid duplicate real-world actions and still plan for later integration and retirement of the old process.
